note: The look of a speeder mechanic's stall at a race crew's hangout (src/systems/world/speeder_stall.gd; layout: content/core/locations/speeder_stall.json). Dorrin's yard colours, so his cousins' stalls read as the same family business: oily steel counter, a rusty top, a striped canvas awning with a string of bulbs, a pegboard rack, a lift pad with hazard edges.
